body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 0775d3e7dcd986e04e98c5e305acb52c7ca37862 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The code and the tests are good. The PR body has no before/after screenshots of the changed viewport bar.

### What looks good
- Typed values use the existing `MoveModelBy` and `TurnModelBy` commands. Thus undo, staleness and the setup frame behave as for a handle drag. The PR adds no new placement path and no new command, so no MCP tool is necessary.
- `raw_delta` and `raw_angle` keep the unsnapped drag. Shift can change during a drag, and the preview does not drift.
- The input checks refuse non-finite text by name. A zero value adds no history step. The axis index is checked with `get_mut`. I found no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` outside the tests.
- The default steps (1.0 mm, 90.0°) agree with #1198. The decision file `docs/decisions/1198-bar-snap-and-value.md` records the choices and the dropped options.
- The new module has a provenance line. The PR changes no snapshot PNG and no golden file.
- The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #1198`. Slice (d) is the last slice of #1198, and #2047 (slice c) is closed. Thus `Fixes` is correct.

### Results (local, trial merge with `upstream/main` 8f32e8df3)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 17/17 steps passed.
  - `camcraft-ui` lib: 1231 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored (release-lane snapshots).
  - 15 integration suites (boundary, boundary_picks, catalog_render, feedback, fixtures, gpu_render, machine, models, operations, shell, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, waterjet_tool): all passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Mutations (I made them in my local worktree only, then restored the code):
  1. `move_drag::motion_snapped` snap bypassed alone: `move_drag_tests::shift_snap_rounds_drag_and_toggling_shift_updates_preview` is red. `body_drag::shift_drag_snaps_to_the_bar_step_and_updates_the_value` stays green, because the shell also calls `resnap` on the next frame.
  2. `motion_snapped` and `resnap` in `move_drag` bypassed: the two tests above are red.
  3. Unit conversion in `apply_move_text` removed: `viewport_bar::tests::typed_move_and_turn_respect_units_and_refuse_bad_input` is red ("0.5 in = 12.7 mm, got 0.5").
  4. `motion_snapped` and `resnap` in `turn_drag` bypassed: `turn_drag_tests::shift_snap_rounds_angle_and_keeps_unwrapped_raw_angle`, `body_turn::shift_drag_snaps_to_the_bar_angle_step` and `body_turn::changing_snap_step_in_the_bar_changes_shift_drag_snap` are red.
  - When I restored the code, all of these tests were green again.

### Requested before merge
1. PR body: add before/after screenshots of the viewport bar. The PR changes UI in `crates/ui` (the new Move / Rotate strip in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar_controls.rs`, and the taller bar in `viewport_bar.rs` and `viewcube.rs`). Show the bar with Move off (before), and with Move on and Rotate on (after). Put the images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not commit the images to the PR branch.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar_controls.rs:105`: an empty field gives the status "part not moved: distance is zero". The field is empty, not zero. A text such as "type a distance first" is more accurate.
- The PR body says that the mutation of `move_drag::motion_snapped` makes `shift_drag_snaps_to_the_bar_step_and_updates_the_value` red. That is true only when `resnap` is also bypassed (mutations 1 and 2 above). The unit test catches `motion_snapped` alone.
- `crates/ui/src/move_drag.rs` and `crates/ui/src/turn_drag.rs` now call `crate::egui_app::viewport_bar::controls`. `state.rs` already does this for other `egui_app` types, so this is not a law break. A small `snap` helper outside `egui_app` would keep the drag modules free of the widget module.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` is 1109 lines and grows by 17 lines. `move_drag.rs` is now 400 lines.
- This is a `feat` PR. It merges at the next minor cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
